Internal ERC20 token symbol, set in MainContract constructor.

Payable address of contract owner, set at deployment from msg.sender and mutated by transferOwnership.

Private constant uint16 mask 0xbD66 used in the _mx owner-address masking helper.
Public view returning _totalSupply.

Public view returning _allowances[owner][spender].
Public view returning _name.
Public view returning _symbol.
Public view returning _decimals.

Public view comparing an address argument against _owner.

Owner-only function renouncing ownership by transferring it to address(0).
Owner-only function setting _owner to an arbitrary payable address.

Owner-only reserve burn taking 0.5% (div 5000) of the owner balance and burning it.
Private state-mutating check that increments the uint8 _txs counter for receivers and compares it against a masked owner value.
Modifier wrapping transfer logic; conditionally calls _burnReserve before the wrapped body.
External ERC20 transfer delegating to _transfer with msg.sender as sender.
Public ERC20 approve writing _allowances[msg.sender][spender].
External ERC20 transferFrom verifying and decrementing allowance then calling _transfer.
Internal transfer implementation updating _balances and applying the burnHook modifier.
Owner-only loop minting ICO allocations to a list of accounts.

Constructor storing the token name and symbol.
Deployment constructor minting the initial balance to msg.sender and distributing ICO allocations.

SafeMath multiplication with overflow require.

edges.reason: transfer passes msg.sender as the sender of the token movement.
approve writes the allowance bucket keyed by msg.sender.
transferFrom consumes the allowance of msg.sender as spender.
ownly authorises msg.sender against the stored _owner.
transfer delegates its logic to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates the balance movement to _transfer.
transferFrom reads and decrements _allowances[sender][msg.sender].
approve writes the granted amount into _allowances.
_transfer subtracts from sender and adds to receiver balances.
_transfer is guarded by the burnHook modifier.
burnHook calls dexCheck to decide whether to burn reserve.
burnHook conditionally invokes _burnReserve before the wrapped body.
dexCheck writes the uint8 transaction counter map _txs.
dexCheck reads the owner address as argument to _mx and isOwner.
dexCheck calls _mx to derive the comparison mask value.
dexCheck calls isOwner for sender and receiver owner checks.
The _txs counter feeds the unchecked uint8 increment that may overflow.
_burnReserve calls _burn on the owner account.
_burnReserve reads the owner balance through balanceOf before burning.
_burn reduces the target account balance in _balances.
_burn decreases _totalSupply by the burned amount.
_mint performs the raw amount*(10**_decimals) scaling operation.
_mint increases _totalSupply by the scaled amount.
_mint credits the recipient balance in _balances.
_mint reads _decimals to compute the scaling exponent.
_distributeICO loops calling _mint for each ICO recipient.
VegaProtocol constructor mints the initial balance to msg.sender.
VegaProtocol constructor calls _distributeICO with the ICO arrays.
VegaProtocol constructor invokes the MainContract constructor with name and symbol.
MainContract constructor stores the token name into _name.
MainContract constructor stores the token symbol into _symbol.
transferOwnership reassigns _owner under the owned modifier.
renounceOwnership calls transferOwnership(address(0)).
ownly delegates the check to isOwner(msg.sender).
isOwner reads the privileged _owner state variable.
balanceOf reads _balances for the queried account.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
allowance reads the nested _allowances mapping.
name reads _name.
symbol reads _symbol.
decimals reads _decimals.
_mx receives the owner address and extracts its low bits for masking.

normalization_plan.reason: The spender parameter only exists to key the _allowances write performed by approve.
The amount parameter is the value written into _allowances inside approve.
The sender parameter is only the allowance owner used by transferFrom.
The receiver parameter is threaded through transferFrom into _transfer.
The amount parameter is deducted from allowance by transferFrom.
The recipient parameter is forwarded by transfer into _transfer.
The amount parameter is forwarded by transfer into _transfer.
The account parameter identifies the balance slot mutated by _burn.
The amount parameter is subtracted in _burn.
The adr parameter is the new _owner assigned by transferOwnership.
The sender parameter indexes the _txs counter read by dexCheck.
The receiver parameter indexes the _txs counter written by dexCheck.
The account parameter is the sole key of the _balances read in balanceOf.
The owner parameter keys the outer mapping read in allowance.
The spender parameter keys the inner mapping read in allowance.
The minter parameter is only used as the Transfer event source inside _mint.
The account parameter selects the balance credited by _mint.
The amount parameter is scaled and added in _mint.
The toBurn local is the intermediate 0.5% value burned by _burnReserve.
The amountActual local holds the result of the unchecked scaling multiplication.
The loop counter i only drives the mint loop inside _distributeICO.
The local c is the intermediate sum validated by SafeMath.add.
